newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND OFFERS PLN 800 MLN OF FIXED BONDS ON MAR 5.
newsitem.headline: POLAND OFFERS PLN 800 MLN OF FIXED BONDS ON MAR 5.

text.p: Poland will offer 800 million zlotys of fixed two-year 15 percent bonds and five-year 12 percent bonds at a tender on March 5, 1997, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said in a statement the value date for the shorter, two-year paper, due June 12, 1999, is March 12, 1997 and the same value date is for the longer, five-year bond, due June 12, 2002.
The Treasury wants to assimilate in June this year this issue of the two-year bonds into a 1994 issue of five year bonds which has the same maturity on June 12, 1999, and had a coupon of 15 percent.
The bonds come from a new three-billion zloty issue of two- and five-year fixed bonds scheduled to be offered at four consecutive tenders from February to May.
The deadline for this auction is on 1100 local time (1000 GMT).
